CJP Founder Begins Indefinite Fast Amidst Ongoing Student Protests

CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke has begun an indefinite fast, taking over from activist Sonam Wangchuk. The protest, which began over exam paper leaks, has evolved into a significant student movement. CJP spokesperson Saurav Das stated the movement will continue, and a march to Parliament is planned. Dipke urged supporters to gather at Jantar Mantar for a July 20 march. Meanwhile, fake images and quotes attributed to Dipke and Wangchuk have circulated online.
